import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Scanner {
        private final InputStream in;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 15];
        private int ptr = 0, len = 0;

        public Scanner(InputStream in) {
            this.in = in;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                len = in.read(buffer);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }

        private boolean skip() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) <= 32 && c != -1) ;
            if (c == -1) return false;
            ptr--;
            return true;
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            if (!skip()) return null;
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) > 32) {
                sb.append((char) c);
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            if (!skip()) throw new IOException();
            int sign = 1;
            int val = 0;
            int c;
            if ((c = read()) == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            do {
                val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
            ptr--;
            return val * sign;
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            if (!skip()) throw new IOException();
            int sign = 1;
            long val = 0;
            int c;
            if ((c = read()) == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            do {
                val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
            } while ((c = read()) >= '0' && c <= '9');
            ptr--;
            return val * sign;
        }

        public double nextDouble() throws IOException {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }

        public void read(int[] arr) throws IOException {
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                arr[i] = nextInt();
            }
        }

        public void read(long[] arr) throws IOException {
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                arr[i] = nextLong();
            }
        }

        public void read(double[] arr) throws IOException {
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                arr[i] = nextDouble();
            }
        }
    }

    static class Printer {
        private final OutputStream out;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 15];
        private int ptr = 0;

        public Printer(OutputStream out) {
            this.out = out;
        }

        private void write(int b) throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= buffer.length) {
                flush();
            }
            buffer[ptr++] = (byte) b;
        }

        public void write(String s) throws IOException {
            for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
                write((byte) s.charAt(i));
            }
        }

        public void write(int v) throws IOException {
            if (v == 0) {
                write('0');
                return;
            }
            if (v < 0) {
                write('-');
                v = -v;
            }
            char[] digits = new char[20];
            int pos = 0;
            while (v > 0) {
                digits[pos++] = (char) ('0' + (v % 10));
                v /= 10;
            }
            while (pos > 0) {
                write((byte) digits[--pos]);
            }
        }

        public void write(long v) throws IOException {
            if (v == 0) {
                write('0');
                return;
            }
            if (v < 0) {
                write('-');
                v = -v;
            }
            char[] digits = new char[20];
            int pos = 0;
            while (v > 0) {
                digits[pos++] = (char) ('0' + (v % 10));
                v /= 10;
            }
            while (pos > 0) {
                write((byte) digits[--pos]);
            }
        }

        public void writeln() throws IOException {
            write('\n');
            flush();
        }

        public void writeln(int v) throws IOException {
            write(v);
            writeln();
        }

        public void writeln(long v) throws IOException {
            write(v);
            writeln();
        }

        public void writeln(String s) throws IOException {
            write(s);
            writeln();
        }

        public void writeSpace() throws IOException {
            write(' ');
        }

        public void flush() throws IOException {
            out.write(buffer, 0, ptr);
            out.flush();
            ptr = 0;
        }
    }

    static class ModInt {
        private int value;
        private static int mod = 998244353;
        private static boolean isPrime = true;

        public ModInt(int v) {
            value = v % mod;
            if (value < 0) value += mod;
        }

        public ModInt(long v) {
            value = (int) (v % mod);
            if (value < 0) value += mod;
        }

        public static void setMod(int m) {
            mod = m;
            isPrime = isPrime(m);
        }

        public int val() {
            return value;
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            value += other.value;
            if (value >= mod) value -= mod;
            return this;
        }

        public ModInt sub(ModInt other) {
            value -= other.value;
            if (value < 0) value += mod;
            return this;
        }

        public ModInt mul(ModInt other) {
            value = (int) ((long) value * other.value % mod);
            return this;
        }

        public ModInt pow(long n) {
            ModInt base = new ModInt(value);
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) {
                    result.mul(base);
                }
                base.mul(base);
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            if (isPrime) {
                return pow(mod - 2);
            } else {
                long[] eg = invGcd(value, mod);
                if (eg[0] != 1) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("Modular inverse does not exist");
                }
                return new ModInt((int) eg[1]);
            }
        }

        public ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return mul(other.inv());
        }

        public static ModInt comb(int n, int k) {
            if (k < 0 || k > n) return new ModInt(0);
            long numerator = 1;
            long denominator = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                numerator = numerator * (n - i) % mod;
                denominator = denominator * (i + 1) % mod;
            }
            return new ModInt((int) (numerator * modInverse(denominator, mod) % mod));
        }

        private static long modInverse(long a, int m) {
            long[] eg = invGcd((int) a, m);
            if (eg[0] != 1) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Modular inverse does not exist");
            }
            return (eg[1] % m + m) % m;
        }

        private static long[] invGcd(int a, int b) {
            int s = b, t = a;
            int m0 = 0, m1 = 1;
            while (t != 0) {
                int u = s / t;
                s -= t * u;
                m0 -= m1 * u;
                int tmp = s;
                s = t;
                t = tmp;
                tmp = m0;
                m0 = m1;
                m1 = tmp;
            }
            if (m0 < 0) m0 += b / s;
            return new long[]{s, m0};
        }

        private static boolean isPrime(int n) {
            if (n <= 1) return false;
            if (n == 2 || n == 7 || n == 61) return true;
            if (n % 2 == 0) return false;
            long d = n - 1;
            while (d % 2 == 0) d /= 2;
            int[] bases = {2, 7, 61};
            for (int a : bases) {
                long t = d;
                long y = powMod(a, t, n);
                while (t != n - 1 && y != 1 && y != n - 1) {
                    y = y * y % n;
                    t <<= 1;
                }
                if (y != n - 1 && t % 2 == 0) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        private static long powMod(long x, long n, int m) {
            if (m == 1) return 0;
            long r = 1;
            x = x % m;
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) r = (r * x) % m;
                x = (x * x) % m;
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return r;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Printer pr = new Printer(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();
        ModInt.setMod(mod);

        ModInt[][] C = new ModInt[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                C[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        C[0][0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = new ModInt(1);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                C[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
                C[i][j].add(C[i - 1][j - 1]);
                C[i][j].add(C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        ModInt[] g = new ModInt[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            g[i] = new ModInt(i * (i + 1) / 2);
        }

        class Pair {
            ModInt first;
            ModInt second;
            Pair(ModInt first, ModInt second) {
                this.first = first;
                this.second = second;
            }
        }

        Pair[] f = new Pair[n + 1];
        f[0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = new Pair(new ModInt(0), new ModInt(0));
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                ModInt z = new ModInt(0);
                z.add(f[j].first);
                z.mul(f[i - 1 - j].first);
                z.mul(C[i - 1][j]);

                f[i].first.add(z);
                f[i].first.mul(new ModInt(i + 1));

                ModInt term1 = new ModInt(0);
                term1.add(g[j]);
                term1.add(g[i - 1 - j]);
                term1.mul(z);

                ModInt term2 = new ModInt(0);
                term2.add(f[i - 1 - j].first);
                term2.mul(f[j].second);
                ModInt term3 = new ModInt(0);
                term3.add(f[j].first);
                term3.mul(f[i - 1 - j].second);
                term2.add(term3);
                term2.mul(C[i - 1][j]);
                term2.mul(new ModInt(i + 1));

                f[i].second.add(term1);
                f[i].second.add(term2);
            }
        }

        ModInt[][] dp = new ModInt[n + 2][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0)).first;

        for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
            for (int r = l + 1; r <= n + 1; r++) {
                int di = r - l - 1;
                for (int i = 0; i + di <= m; i++) {
                    ModInt z = new ModInt(0);
                    z.add(dp[l][i]);
                    z.mul(f[di].first);
                    z.mul(comb(i + di, di));

                    dp[r][i + di].add(dp[l][i].second);
                    dp[r][i + di].mul(f[di].first);
                    ModInt term2 = new ModInt(0);
                    term2.add(dp[l][i].first);
                    term2.mul(f[di].second);
                    dp[r][i + di].add(term2);
                    dp[r][i + di].mul(comb(i + di, di));
                }
            }
        }

        pr.writeln(dp[n + 1][m].second.val());
        pr.flush();
    }

    private static ModInt comb(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return new ModInt(0);
        long numerator = 1;
        long denominator = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            numerator = numerator * (n - i) % ModInt.mod;
            denominator = denominator * (i + 1) % ModInt.mod;
        }
        return new ModInt((int) (numerator * modInverse(denominator, ModInt.mod) % ModInt.mod));
    }

    private static long modInverse(long a, int m) {
        long[] eg = invGcd((int) a, m);
        if (eg[0] != 1) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Modular inverse does not exist");
        }
        return (eg[1] % m + m) % m;
    }

    private static long[] invGcd(int a, int b) {
        int s = b, t = a;
        int m0 = 0, m1 = 1;
        while (t != 0) {
            int u = s / t;
            s -= t * u;
            m0 -= m1 * u;
            int tmp = s;
            s = t;
            t = tmp;
            tmp = m0;
            m0 = m1;
            m1 = tmp;
        }
        if (m0 < 0) m0 += b / s;
        return new long[]{s, m0};
    }
}
